title: Buffett Bet $1M Against Wall Street's Best 🤯 #shorts
description:
In 2007 Warren Buffett bet $1 million that a plain S&P 500 index fund would beat a hand-picked group of hedge funds over 10 years. The index fund gained 125.8%; the best fund-of-funds gained 87.7%.
Source: Berkshire Hathaway 2017 Shareholder Letter ("The Bet" is Over); CNN Money, Feb 24 2018; CNBC, Feb 16 2018. Past results don't predict future returns. Education, not financial advice.
script: Warren Buffett bet a million dollars that a boring fund would beat Wall Street's best.
His pick: a simple S and P five hundred index fund. Then do nothing for ten years.
The other side picked five funds that owned over two hundred hedge funds.
Ten years later, the index fund was up one hundred twenty-five point eight percent.
The best pros? Eighty-seven point seven. One fund made just two point eight.
The reason? Fees. Paid every single year, win or lose.
Buffett's charity got over two point two million dollars.
Performance comes and goes. Fees never do.
